The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei fall in love. Yet the film turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master named Shadow Whip, he is suspected and hunted.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Hsiao Fang is a young girl not afraid to fight back against hooligans. Unfortunately, she mistakes the handsome Ma Ta-hai, for one such hoodlum. The two are immediately attracted but refuse to admit their true feelings.

programme.title: The Crimson Charm
programme.desc: The tale of a noble swordsman and a one-armed swordswoman who find themselves up against the evil Crimson Charm gang of thieves and thugs.

programme.title: The Tiger And The Widow
programme.desc: In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. The union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld Kings sister and the Winged Tiger.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love.

programme.title: Descendant Of The Sun
programme.desc: A magic solar baby is sent Earthbound by a benevolent god and raised by an old carpenter. He has martial arts superpowers and green kryptonite loses them during solar eclipses.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword masters daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor Danny Lee plays a motorbike workshop owner who injured during an illegal motorcycle race and continues to race regardless of the physical consequences and the law.

programme.title: Demon Of The Lute
programme.desc: The lute-demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng-ling is ordered to find a special bow and arrow that can counter the demon.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix is yet another masterpiece from director Li Han-hsiang. It is a comedy surrounded the upcoming marriage of the imperial ministers daughter.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: The patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70s Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: Sword Stained With Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from the novel by Jin Yong, havoc breaks out when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, training manual, treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased master.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My 12 Lovers?
programme.desc: Six guitar playing, rock and roll singing and dancing young people on a boating trip are stranded on a rural island off of Hong Kong during a typhoon. They become suspicious of a woman (Jenny Hu) who matches the radio bulletin description of a murderess who killed twelve men. Can she be trusted? Is she laying a trap for a local youth (Chin Han) housesitting a mansion?

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his “Crazy Lo Han Fist” improves with every fight.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide.

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: A young and learned martial artist is tasked by the Qing emperor to spy on dissents in another province who plan to overthrow him. He infiltrates the rebel leaders large estate by becoming his granddaughters private live in tutor.

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Jimmy Wang Yu plays the son of a police chief, who falls for a sexy dancing girl and gambles for cash. When the girl is raped he swears to defy his father and seek revenge!

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: A framed kung-fu master seeks revenge after 15 years in prison. He survives one attempt on his life after another! An intriguing, exciting production which weaves mystery and suspense with kung-fu action.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun plays the replacement hired for a popular band whose egotistic drummer quit to join a rival group.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: The tale of two imperial concubines vying for the emperors favor.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: Several years before GHOSTBUSTERS was a massive Hollywood hit, Wong Jing scripted this hilarious supernatural action comedy starring Alexander Fu and directed by Lau Ka Wing.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He doesnt believe in the rumors, but after running into a Taoist swordsman, he meets a beautiful lady ghost.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist kills his master and entire clan, the Iron Buddha sets out for revenge. Hell need a magic sword first though, naturally.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong societys differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Cheng-ying and his sister ingratiate themselves into the life of the diabolical Lin Hao, as they plot to avenge their fathers death, with a little help from the lethal titular move.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: An award winning movie for best script and best editing. Another tale of a Sino-Japanese war that artistically and emotional triumphed, it clearly portrays the life of wartime.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: This tale of hidden treasure and a young wushu warrior in the Valley of Villains is considered among the best from director Chu Yuan and celebrated author Ku Lung. Making the production even more special is the presence of international favorite Alexander Fu Sheng.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: One day, Miu Ling rescues an injured secret agent who promises to make her his apprentice. From then on, her life is turned upside down and she goes onto a roller-coaster of madcap adventures.

programme.title: Tales From Occult: Malevolence
programme.desc: The final chapter of Tales From The Occult, features three short stories. The stories reveal the most terrifying and ugly side of human nature, where life and death are just a thought away!

programme.title: Customs Frontline
programme.desc: Hong Kong customs officers discover illegal weapons on a cargo ship and trace them back to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover, uncovering a transnational operation with roots closer to home.

programme.title: Life Hotel
programme.desc: Li Qingrang, a former street thug, encountered setbacks in his attempts to find a job after being released from prison.

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: Chi is a property agent who leads an aimless and unfulfilling life until he reunites with his P.E. teacher, Wong, from primary school. Despite his illness, Wong insists on keeping his promise of completing a 10K marathon to his late wife. Inspired by Wong, Chi brings himself to his feet and finds the courage to cheer himself on!

programme.title: Quan Dao: Journey Of A Boxer
programme.desc: When Xings son attempts drug trafficking to save his fathers studio but fails and is brutally beaten up, Ah Niu accepts a death combat challenge so as to help him take revenge.

programme.title: Ready O/R Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship.

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: This is based on a true story. A sudden earthquake hits the gas pipes in an industrial park, triggering massive explosions and engulfing the neighboring area in flames. When the Fire Rescue Force reaches the scene, firefighters must fight against the flames and time, as they commit to safeguard lives with their own.

programme.title: Lost Love
programme.desc: Chan Tin Mei (Sammi Cheng) and Ho Bun (Alan Luk)s son passes away abruptly at just three years old due to congenital heart disease. Suffering in unfathomable pain over the loss, Mei resists having another child. One day, Mei finds out that they can become a foster family.

programme.title: Social Distancing
programme.desc: After seeing a warning video about an e-ghost on YouTube, Cherry begins to encounter many mysterious incidents. She must face her unbearable past in order to get out of this horrifying paranormal world.

programme.title: Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee is the Production head of an advertising firm who tries to improve her teams performance by competing with Creative head Chan in the day and clubbing at Lan Kwai Fong for ideas at night.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: A businessman Qin Guo Li is being kidnapped in London and his daughter is also in danger. The international security team, Vanguard, is hired to rescue them. In the process, they discover another dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: The Wolf Pack squad led by Lao Diao, is a foreign-based team that specializes in overseas security jobs. In one of the missions, the squad discovers that a terrorist force is planning to destroy the country’s energy source. Lao Diao is now entrusted with the task of leading his squad to fight back. Can the Wolf Pack save the day?

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of policeman Lok Jat Jin was murdered, and the method of killing was extremely cruel. All of this pointed to the desperate criminal Sung Ging Naam.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: Security guard Lee Go is assigned to keep guard at a house while the owner is away. However, a series of hilarious misunderstandings occur.

programme.title: Wild City
programme.desc: A cop-turned-bar owner befriends a drunken woman and finds himself pursued by her former lover and the thugs he employs.

programme.title: Leio
programme.desc: An ex-singer Kao returns to his hometown for a funeral and takes part in a water drilling contest to save his drought-stricken hometown, as well as to win a million dollar cash prize.

programme.title: A Murder Erased
programme.desc: Police officer Choi is assigned to a death scene investigation where the deceased body had laid undiscovered for eight years. A prosecutor who joins the investigation finds Chois actions suspicious.

programme.title: From Vegas To Macau
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat stars as "Magic Hands" Ken, a legendary gambling maestro who is forced out of retirement when his daughters safety is compromised by an international gambling mafia. In order to save her, Ken and his new protege Cool must work together to expose the evil mastermind by challenging him to a high stakes head-to-head battle of cards.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon 2
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Chasing The Dragon (2020)
programme.desc: Xu, a rookie officer, manages to solve a robbery case but gets demoted for offending a corrupt senior. He attempts to rise through the ranks by winning the heart of a rich woman.

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career but Adam still wants to make up and tries to move her 77 times. Things become more complicated when a Thai movie idol courts Eva. It is at this time that Eva’s mother becomes very ill, and she considers marriage in order to fulfil her mother’s wish. Will Adam succeed in warming Eva’s heart?

programme.title: Everything Is Unknown
programme.desc: Pan Yi Ming receives his fathers will stating that he must attend his funeral at home to claim the huge inheritance. When he returns home, he encounters his ex-girlfriend, her husband Hua Qi and his daughter whom he has never met.

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Schemes In Antiques
programme.desc: When an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his familys reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Once In A Blue Moon
programme.desc: Mei-chun longs to reunite with her estranged father, her brother conceals his separation from his wife, and their mother harbors guilt over her husbands past departure. Can this troubled family overcome secrets and reconcile?

programme.title: Mr. and Mrs. Player
programme.desc: Chinese Feng Shui master, Carson was a Natural Born Player, taking names and breaking hearts. Fate had it that he would meet his match, the hot veterinarian, Chi-Ling.

programme.title: Closing Bell: Overtime

programme.title: Fast Money

programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko tells of a child of a goldfish who is very independent, even though he is an only child. Kiko who is always cheerful has four good friends, namely Lola the discus fish, Ting Ting the crab, Patino the catfish and Poli the betta fish. On the other hand, the antagonists, Karkus the catfish and Pupus the eel, always make Kikos life chaotic. One day, the lake where Kiko lives is polluted due to the reckless acts of humans, causing Kiko and friends to turn into mutants.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda Sang Pendekar
programme.desc: After Po is tapped to become the Spiritual Leader of the Valley of Peace, he needs to find and train a new Dragon Warrior, while a wicked sorceress plans to re-summon all the master villains whom Po has vanquished to the spirit realm.

programme.title: Hafizah
programme.desc: Since childhood, Hafizah ( Olivia Jensen ) has lived in an orphanage without knowing who her parents are. Many people like her simple, cheerful and tomboyish attitude. Unfortunately, on her 18th birthday, Hafizah had to leave the orphanage according to applicable regulations. Hafizahs life changed. He is invited to work at the house of Widuri ( Ade Irawan ), a rich grandmother who is known for being fierce and angry. Hafizahs outspoken attitude resulted in her often clashing with Widuri. Surya ( Ferry Salim ), Widuris son, and wife, Vani ( Cut Tari ), persuade Hafizah to feel at home working. In fact, its not only Widuri who has to be faced, but also Ryan ( Galih Ginanjar ), his grandson. Ryans reckless behavior causes them to often fight. Slowly, Hafizah learned that Ryans behavior was because his parents household was unhappy.
